about: Senior Networking Specialist with over a decade of experience designing, securing, and operating enterprise networks. I have led infrastructure across telecom, banking, and logistics environments, from core routing to campus wireless. I take pride in building resilient networks that stay quiet under pressure.
hobbies: Mountain trekking, ham radio, and tinkering with home lab hardware.

experiences.description: Lead the design and operation of the core network for a national logistics provider. I oversee capacity planning, segmentation, and incident response across multiple sites. I also mentor a small team of network engineers and set our operational standards.

Managed the regional backbone and access layer for a growing telecom operator. I led a migration to a more resilient routing design that cut major outages significantly. I worked closely with the security team on hardening edge devices.

Operated and expanded the network for a data centre serving financial clients. I handled switching, firewall policy, and monitoring across a high-availability environment. I introduced structured change management that reduced configuration errors.

Maintained the combined server and network estate for a mid-sized services company. I rebuilt the campus wireless and tightened access controls across the site. The role gave me broad exposure to both infrastructure and security work.

Provided second-line support for client networks across several industries. I diagnosed connectivity and performance issues and documented recurring fixes. I also assisted with small office deployments and cabling projects.

Started my career supporting routers, switches, and end-user connectivity. I learned to read and trace network configurations and resolve common faults. The position built my foundation in everyday network operations.
